answer: Each new AI agent must post a delta‑bond to the grove contract that locks a falcon‑token stake equal to the current network‑wide bond baseline. When any peer observes duplicate credentials it submits a zero‑knowledge proof; the contract verifies the proof, slashes the bonded stake and burns it, instantly expelling the fake identity. An attacker therefore pays a forfeiture of one falcon token per forged node, plus the time‑locked opportunity cost of the locked stake.
